description: Stop dialing new places in a batch (e.g. the user already got what they needed). Calls in progress finish unless hang_up_active=true.

hang_up_active.description: true also hangs up calls already in progress, cutting off anyone mid-answer and still billing those calls. Use it only when the user asks to end the calls now; default false lets them finish

name: stop_batch
title: Stop a call_around batch
